release.content: pubsec 0.4.0 was released on 2026-11-25 from commit 8f5f1b6415af80dd44cc2ab63ecfc6a65855897a with these changes.

rows: The suite reaches pubdeploy through pubdeploy.contract and pubdeploy.testing alone (a scenario checks it): the contract's Context names come from pubdeploy.contract, the canary walks with walk_needs, and gcloud's fake (accounts, keys, the service-account-key steps) is the suite's own
pubsec run names the secrets it read (From Bitwarden:) and those it skipped only when stderr is a terminal; off one, as in a CI log that may be public, it gives only their number

github.variable takes a declared variable's default (the variables block's, version 2; any JSON value): unset or empty, it is ready at its default, shown as default (VALUE), and set to a value equal to it, compared canonically, says so; without one, unset or empty is missing as before
